name: Runway landing page by runwayml.com
description: A cinematic, monochrome landing page where full-bleed imagery does the persuading and a neutral grotesque with tight tracking carries the copy. The page alternates between airy white sections (partner strip, three-column platform grid, tabbed showcase, 2×2 news grid) and two immersive bands — a misty forest hero with left-aligned white type and a blurred olive-green research band with hairline-divided link lists. Everything is flat and shadow-free: hierarchy comes from a strong scale jump (56px display → 14px body), bold-vs-regular weight, and gray secondary text, while buttons stay in three quiet tiers (black filled, light-gray filled, white/outline on imagery) and a dense black link-column footer closes the page.
